reviews.name: Ashish Agarwal
reviews.review: Trek To Shikhar provided brilliant experience for my first trek. They had amazing facilities, warm four-season tents, and provided guidance of utmost quality. The certified NIM guides were patient and motivating throughout the summit climb. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mayank Bhardwaj
reviews.review: Nag Tibba with Trek To Shikhar was well-planned and smoothly executed. The trek leaders explained the trail well and motivated the group throughout the difficult stretches. Fresh hot meals at sub-zero base camp was a blessing.

reviews.name: Kamal Sarkar
reviews.review: Brahmatal Trek exceeded expectations in every way! The team maintained a perfect balance of safety and enjoyment. Medical pulse oximeter checks twice daily and reliable high-altitude sleeping bags kept us warm at -5°C.

reviews.name: Priya Sharma
reviews.review: Kedarkantha sunrise summit was pure magic! As a solo female trekker, I felt 100% safe and respected. Strict 12-15 batch size meant genuine personal care. Microspikes and gaiters were provided on spot for the snow trail.

reviews.name: Rahul Verma
reviews.review: Hatu Peak alpine ridge trail was breathtaking! Equipment was spotless—waterproof dome tents and clean thermal sleeping bags kept us warm. The certified guides are born locals with deep mountain respect. Booking Kuari Pass next!

reviews.name: Sunita Rawat
reviews.review: Churdhar Peak sanctuary trek was thrilling! The team monitored hydration and acclimatization with immense care. Zero plastic on trail, transparent pricing, and authentic mountain hospitality. 5 stars all the way!

reviews.name: Kunal Malhotra
reviews.review: Having trekked across Uttarakhand with several commercial agencies, Trek To Shikhar stands in a league of its own. Capping batches strictly at 12–15 trekkers ensures zero trail chaos and medical-grade expedition safety.

reviews.name: Tanvi Kapoor
reviews.review: From seamless pickup at Dehradun station to reaching the summit ridge, every logistical detail was flawless. The trek leaders are genuine mountaineers who prioritize safety first. Best Himalayan trekking operator hands down!
